nodes.name: content
nodes.summary: Embedded HTML and CSS content for the Illy onboarding guide. Contains a comprehensive guide for the GTM/Sales/Marketing role at Masterminds HQ, including sections on mission, setup, team management, sales operations, and strategic planning. Auto-generated from guide-v2/illy-guide.html.

nodes.name: GUIDE_HTML
nodes.summary: Large HTML string containing the complete Illy onboarding guide with embedded CSS. Includes styled sections for mission overview, setup instructions, team management, sales operations, and strategic guidance. Renders with a dark theme (Masterminds brand colors) and sticky navigation with table of contents.

nodes.name: giveaways
nodes.summary: Giveaway registry and utility library. Defines the Giveaway interface and maintains a curated list of 23 free resources/lead-magnets including quizzes, guides, tools, and skill templates. Provides utility function to retrieve giveaways by slug.

nodes.name: Giveaway
nodes.summary: TypeScript interface defining the structure of a giveaway resource. Contains fields for slug (unique identifier), title, description, icon (Unicode symbol), badge label, and badge color variant (purple or pink).

nodes.name: giveaways
nodes.summary: Exported array of 23 Giveaway objects serving as the master registry. Each entry represents a free resource or lead-magnet (e.g., 'The Cost Stack Audit', 'AI Levels Quiz', 'All Sorted Overview', 'Claude Code Web Designer Agent Kit'). Used as the single source of truth for the giveaways index page.

nodes.name: getGiveaway
nodes.summary: Utility function that retrieves a single Giveaway by its slug identifier. Returns the matching Giveaway object or undefined if not found. Enables dynamic lookup of giveaway details by URL slug.

nodes.name: illy/page
nodes.summary: Next.js page component that renders the Illy onboarding guide. Implements password-based authentication (via query param or cookie) before displaying the GUIDE_HTML content. Uses crypto for secure password verification.

nodes.name: giveaways/page
nodes.summary: Next.js page component that renders the giveaways index listing. Displays all giveaways as an interactive grid/list with icons, titles, descriptions, and badges. Iterates over the giveaways array and links to individual giveaway pages.
